ocean.title: We start where the community already rides.
ocean.body: Blob is starting out between Hourtin, Carcans, Lacanau and Bordeaux to test a simple idea: better connect riders, pros and useful local deals.

why.title: Why Blob?
why.intro1: Blob is starting as a local beta around surfing and kitesurfing in the Médoc Atlantique.
why.intro2: The idea is simple: see whether a community can help riders, beginners and pros find each other more easily, share the right info and build useful perks together.

beta.label: Local beta
beta.body: We're starting in the Médoc Atlantique, without closing the door to riders from Bordeaux.

free.label: Free & no commitment
free.body: During the test phase, signing up is free. The goal is to observe real usage and improve Blob with feedback from the community.

community.label: Useful for the community
community.body: Articles, tips and good deals will arrive gradually. The more the community grows, the more interesting offers Blob can secure for riders, beginners and pros.
